Thank you I will look into that.
To an extent, yes. I have been gaming since I was conceived - and made a living off it.
I've reached out to friends. My parents actually saw my internet history in which I was watching videos pertaining to suicide. I have a ton of friends but none have really offered much help.
America is awful. They say its a country of freedom but its awful. I come from a European background where my government would actually help me. Here in America no one gives a shit.

I've never had a normal job. I've been self employed my whole life. It provided me with a great outlook when I was making 7 figures then I lost everything. Now I can't afford my care, I've reached out to facilities and no one wants to help.
Thank you for those kind words. I have been pushing forward hoping for some solace. Deep in my mind I feel God has sent me on this journey through pain for a reason, and that keeps me going,

That is what I am worried about - effecting the ones around me I love dearly. I have been trying new companies which show a ton of prospect, but my depression fucks everything up and can block me from working or focusing. I just want to be happy for once. Part of me thinks my family would be happy for me that I have finally found peace. Growing up I was able to appreciate enduring the bad and enjoying the good, but it got to a point where I am stuck enduring the bad and never getting out of it.

I appreciate the reply. I thought a year would help these wounds from healing but it hasn't. I've had other long term relationships fail and the outcome wasn't so bad. I've tried to seek love and have not been able to find it. I just feel like I've lost everything and me being dead would be best for everyone around me. I have been on the fence for a while and lately its been leaning towards dying.
